summary: Added email preference storage and management system: extended storage.js with EMAIL_PREFERENCES storage key and per-user preference functions (email, unsubscribe_status, snooze_until fields); created src/utils/email-preferences.js with getEmailPreferences, updateEmail, setUnsubscribed, setSnoozePeriod, areRemindersActive functions plus email validation; created api/email-preferences.js POST endpoint with validation for userId, email format, unsubscribe status, and snooze days including early-return error handling following existing patterns.
